# Hills Camp Kerala

> Curated luxury staycations and wilderness retreats across Kerala's Western Ghats — Wayanad, Munnar, Vagamon, and the backwaters.

Hills Camp is a boutique travel platform that handpicks heritage stays, glamping retreats, treehouses, and homestays in Kerala. We also curate guided treks and experiences across South India.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of featured retreats and experiences.
- [About](/about): Our story, philosophy, and team.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the team via WhatsApp, email, or enquiry form.

## Stays

- [All Stays](/listings): Browse every handpicked property.
- [Wayanad Resorts](/wayanad-resorts): Luxury resorts and retreats in Wayanad.
- [Munnar Homestays](/munnar-homestays): Boutique homestays in Munnar's tea country.

## Experiences

- [Experiences & Treks](/experiences): Curated treks, safaris, and adventures.
